title: Breast Cancer: Screening: women aged 40 to 74 years

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends biennial screening mammography for women aged 40 to 74 years.

all.note: Age evaluated at end of measurement year; the text does not specify the evaluation point.

derived.window: 'biennial' means every 2 years, so for a December-31 check a mammogram in the measurement year or the prior year ({MY-1}-01-01 to {MY}-12-31) satisfies it
